1.consolidated_definition: "Bufear": emitir un sonido fuerte y brusco, similar a un rugido o un gruñido, generalmente expresando ira, sorpresa o frustración; sustantivo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To bellow: to emit a loud and abrupt sound, similar to a growl or a grunt, typically expressing anger, surprise, or frustration; noun.
